answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. The upshot is a network where trust is a resource you earn, not a quantity you can mint — and that is what keeps Sybil attacks economically unviable. Consider a saffron as the anchor of the cost.
